name: Aelnir Brain Puzzle
seoTitle: Aelnir Brain Puzzle: offline puzzle collection for Android
summary: Sliding tiles, number sequences, pipes, memory and lights-out, in short offline sessions.
tagline: A pocket of logic puzzles built for a few minutes at a time. Every level is generated on your phone and checked to be solvable.

features.title: Five puzzles, short sessions
features.lead: No account, no backend, no internet needed.

items.title: Sliding tiles
items.body: Classic 3×3 and 4×4 boards, with hints that point at the next move.

items.title: Number sequence
items.body: Find the rule and the missing number, with nudges if you get stuck.

items.title: Pipe connect
items.body: Rotate the tiles until water flows from the source to every end.

items.title: Memory sequence
items.body: Watch the pattern, then repeat it back.

items.title: Lights out
items.body: Switch every light off, with an optimal-move hint when you need it.

items.title: Daily challenge
items.body: A new offline puzzle every day, with stars, streaks and achievements to collect.

strip.label: Puzzles
strip.text: Sliding tiles · Number sequence · Pipes · Memory · Lights out

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Fair levels, made on your phone
note.body: Aelnir Brain Puzzle is free and supported by ads. Each of the 60 levels per puzzle is generated from a seed, solved by a solver and saved only on your device.

studioProof.hard: Every level is generated from a seed, solver-validated and scored for difficulty, all on the device.
